## Download

- **Windows 10 or 11:** `Heard-Setup-<version>.exe`. The installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **macOS 13 or later, Apple Silicon (M1 or newer):** `Heard-<version>-arm64.dmg`. Open it and drag Heard to Applications.

On first launch, add an API key for your AI in Settings. Your first recording downloads the speech model (about 130 MB); after that, transcription works offline.

Once it's installed, Heard looks for new versions itself, downloads them, and installs them when you restart it. The other files below are what it updates from.

**On a Mac with Heard 0.2.1 or earlier,** install this version by hand once: download the `.dmg` above and drag Heard to Applications to replace the old one. Those versions can't install updates themselves. macOS asks for microphone and screen-audio permission once more, and from then on Heard updates itself.
